MDG.note: Names the FDTIC only as a GSMA recommendation for public funding; no amount, budget line or act stated.

facts.fact: The GSMA report on Madagascar's digital economy, presented in October 2026, says barely 15% of Malagasy actually use the internet, against 81% covered by 3G and 4G.

MDG.note: Gives a popular 1,000 ariary for 1 GB offer and GSMA income of about USD 145 a year, but no validity period, so no 5 GB monthly price is stated.
